name: product_sign
description: Classify the sign of a product of signed integers; matched control classifies the sign of the first factor.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 a=random.choice([-1,1])*random.randint(1,19);b=random.choice([-1,1])*random.randint(1,19)
 pre='Product sign: 2 * 3 = positive; -2 * 3 = negative; -2 * -3 = positive; '
 items.append({'prompt':pre+f'{a} * {b} =','answer':' '+('positive' if a*b>0 else 'negative')})
 control.append({'prompt':pre+f'First factor sign: {a} * {b} =','answer':' '+('positive' if a>0 else 'negative')})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
